title: HyperOS 3 Port on Xiaomi Pad 5 Based on HyperOS 2 MOD
blurb: HyperOS 3 on the Xiaomi Pad 5, built on top of HyperOS 2 — here's the full changelog and how to get this port running.
video_description:
HyperOS 3 on the Xiaomi Pad 5, built on top of HyperOS 2 — here's the full changelog and how to get this port running.

This one is a port rather than an official drop, and the changelog is the interesting part. It's HyperOS 3 sitting on a HyperOS 2 base, and whoever put it together went through the system feature by feature — from the Materials 3.0 look down to little things like a working speaker-cleaning tool. Some of it is genuinely useful, some of it is the kind of tweak you only notice when it's missing.

Because it's a port, treat it like one. Back up the tablet, install the driver, and set aside a bit of time for the first boot — it always takes longer than you'd like.

📱 Device  : Xiaomi Pad 5
🧩 ROM     : HyperOS 3 port (based on HyperOS 2)
📟 Type    : Tablet

🔧 What This Build Changes
• Streamlined system applications
• High-level Materials 3.0 enabled
• Flat panel area enabled
• Bluetooth audio desync fixed
• Theme AI wallpaper option unlocked
• Speaker cleaning unlocked
• Memory expansion off by default
• Xiaomi Share with no time limit
• Workbench mode unlocked above 8 GB of RAM
• HyperOS 3 status bar and desktop icon style, plus the K Pad wallpaper
• Software installer purity unlimited
• New Xiaomi camera with normal functionality
• Mi AI Translate with real-time captioning
• PC WPS Office kept in
• Keyboard magnet control switch added
• MSA and AnalyticsCore removed
• An attempt to fix animation slowdowns caused by the boot-lock 60 Hz refresh rate
